title: MONEY IN THE RAID CORNER READS $
why: His rule (Q59): $ for money. In a raid the corner column still read credits 900, and the stash and backpack values had no $, while the Undercroft line already read $900.
now: In a raid the corner reads $900 with no credits word, and the stash and backpack values read $ there and in the Undercroft.

edits.replacement: STASH $'+sv.toLocaleString()+' BAG $'+bv.toLocaleString()+''; // v33.xx (cw-raiddollar): his Q59, the stash and bag values are money
